captions.detailed: This 3D model features a tall, light-gray portable air conditioning unit with rounded vertical edges. It has a black horizontal louvered vent on its front side, a black control panel on the top surface containing a dark rotary dial and two light-gray rectangular buttons, and dual-wheel casters underneath. The louver door rotates on a horizontal axis, the top dial rotates continuously, the buttons can be depressed vertically, and the caster wheels spin freely on their axles.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a portable air conditioning unit with a tall, rounded rectangular body in light gray. It should feature a front louvered outlet vent, a top control panel with a rotary dial and two push-buttons, and bottom caster wheels, ensuring proper articulation for the louver, dial, buttons, and wheels.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a filleted Box primitive, then subtract a pocket for the top control panel. Create the louvered vent as a separate part using thin boxes or a customized grille shape. Model the control panel components with a cylindrical dial and small box buttons, and construct the bottom casters using cylinders for wheels and axles. Assemble the parts using revolute joints for the louver, continuous joints for the dial and caster wheels, and prismatic joints for the buttons.
